description: This PHP source file provides APIs for accessing and manipulating the Data Model parameters, including functions to retrieve, set, add, and delete object instances within a router or network device's configuration schema.

methods.name: DmGetStrsWithRootObj
methods.description: Retrieve multiple parameter values with a common root object using an external extension API.

methods.name: DmSetStrsWithRootObj
methods.description: Set multiple parameter values under a common root object using an external extension API.
